evals.prompt: I just opened __PR_URL__ as a draft - babysit it until it's green and reviewed
evals.expected_output: Waits for CI with wait-checks, fixes and pushes failures until green, runs gh pr ready, waits for Copilot, hands the comments to my-pr-review-comments with its confirmations, waits for CI again, prints the itemized summary with commit SHAs.

evals.prompt: CI on my PR __PR_URL__ is red, fix it and get it ready for review
evals.expected_output: Uses failed-logs to diagnose, distinguishes PR-caused vs flaky vs pre-existing failures, does not disable checks, stops and asks after repeated failed fix attempts, then continues with the ready/Copilot flow.

evals.prompt: autopilot __PR_URL__ - this repo doesn't auto-request Copilot
evals.expected_output: After marking ready, wait-copilot returns not-requested and Copilot is requested automatically via gh pr edit --add-reviewer @copilot without asking; only one Copilot round is done.
